draft.reply:
Hi,

Thanks for flagging this. This matches a known issue (KI-120): time tracking entries submitted from the mobile app before app version 4.2 can show the wrong timezone.

The recommended workaround is to re-submit the affected entry from the web app instead of the mobile app, which will save it with the correct timezone.

I'd also recommend updating to the latest version of the mobile app, since this issue is tied to versions prior to 4.2.

Let us know if you run into any further issues after re-submitting the entries.

Best,
Loopwise Support
